base of first distal phalanx of foot: A zone of bone organ forming the proximal articular end of the distal phalanx of the hallux, presenting a concave surface that articulates with the head of the proximal phalanx at the interphalangeal joint of the great toe.
base of first proximal phalanx of foot: A zone of bone organ forming the proximal end of the proximal phalanx of the hallux, presenting a broad oval concave articular surface that receives the head of the first metatarsal at the metatarsophalangeal joint.
head of second distal phalanx of hand: A zone of bone organ forming the distal articular end of the second distal phalanx of the hand, presenting a smooth convex surface at the tip of the index finger; it bears no distal joint and is capped by the ungual tuberosity.
head of second middle phalanx of hand: A zone of bone organ forming the distal articular end of the middle phalanx of the second finger, presenting a trochlear articular surface that articulates with the base of the second distal phalanx at the distal interphalangeal joint of the index finger.
